_howto: Network-wide ad schedule (all Gather sites that opt in). Edit this file, run tools/sl-ad-schedule.py --check, then --upload. Sites read it from Vercel Blob (ads/schedule.json) at request time, so no deploy. Dates are inclusive ISO yyyy-mm-dd, Central time. end null = open-ended. One campaign per site+slot per day.
